A card becomes COMPLETED only with an independent APPROVED review, the full reviewed commit SHA, an evidence file, all six completion checklist items verified, and every dependency already COMPLETED. The helper refuses any other transition.

## 4. Open gaps by item

### T003 — Approve accounting policies, resource bounds and golden fixtures (OWNER_DECISION)

- A named qualified methodology owner and independent reviewer must approve supported framework editions and effective periods (R2R-ADR-04), consolidation profiles (R2R-ADR-09), and FX methodology beyond ADR-0014 (R2R-ADR-03).
- A versioned framework and edition policy registry backing FrameworkPolicyRef, after its supported values are professionally approved.
- Approval and independent review for all eight GOLD-R2R fixture outcomes, then executable tests for the six fixtures without tests.
- Owner and technical review of section 10.1 resource limits; record any deferred limits and publish a versioned resource policy.
- Do not mark T003 complete until approved policy records, fixture approvals, required tests, and the card-level independent review are recorded.

### T004 — Make command and query boundaries explicit as static services without changing transaction behavior (PARTIAL)

- After T003, inspect one representative command and query and record the owning service, API boundary, and current wire behavior.
- Complete a transaction-owner registry and an architecture check for the selected single-owner invariant.
- Record observed before/after or characterization evidence for the selected command/query without changing business behavior.

### T006 — Establish the layered verification harness (xUnit, PostgreSQL, Angular specs, Playwright) (PARTIAL)

- After T005, inspect the current xUnit, PostgreSQL, Angular spec, and Playwright lanes and record the shared fixture and evidence conventions required by the revised card.
- Record exact current-tree commands, database/schema isolation, run commit, and observed results; do not infer completion from test counts or named cases.

### T014 — Activate exact reporting contexts and verify Module 20 setup (PARTIAL)

- Complete T013 dimension-schema revision work and T007 shared scoped-identity work before implementation.
- Add immutable exact context pins and server-side scope/currentness validation; do not duplicate existing accounting entities or resolve by display name.
- Implement named bind/get Application operations and the canonical Angular selector with change-impact preview.
- Replace implicit chart selection and bind import/package evidence to the exact context revision; validate profile and legal-entity keys against server-owned records.
- Verify sibling-client denial, successor-context invalidation, prior-chart resolution, and the full setup-to-import handoff.
